addModuleDescription: Creating a new file lets you declare classes or functions outside the main code in sketch.js. It runs alongside your sketch, so you can reference it anywhere.
addPageDescription: Pages sit beside the overview, for anything that would crowd it — setup steps, what the parameters mean, or how to read what the visual draws.
allowMappingHelp: Lets the parameter be mapped to a device. Otherwise, it will be limited to manual controls.
authoredHelp: Show the visual in full screen when opened and require connection to the data sources listed by you.
authoredNeedsMapping: Authored mode requires all parameters to have a default mapping to work properly.
clampHelp: Keeps values coming in from a data source inside the range. Otherwise, values past it reach the visual as they are.
controlledByData: The parameter is controlled by your data
coverComing: Cover images are coming with the visuals bank.
deleteFileBody: This file will be removed from the visual. This cannot be undone.
deleteFileTitle: Are you sure you want to delete it?
deletePageBody: This page and everything written on it will be removed. This cannot be undone.
deletePageTitle: Are you sure you want to delete it?
docsInvite: Explain what this visual shows and what a participant should do.
linkDataSourceDescription: Link a data source to drive this visual's parameters from a device.
mappingTurnedOff: Mapping is turned off for this parameter. Turn on Allow Mapping in its settings to connect it to a device.
name: Name
nameNeedsLetter: Start the name with a letter.
nameTaken: There is already a parameter called “{{key}}”.
noDataSourcesBody: Link a data source to connect a device, then map its outputs onto this visual's parameters from the Parameters tab.
noDataSourcesViewer: This visual doesn't use any devices. Its parameters are set by hand.
noNumericOutputs: This source has no numeric outputs to map.
noParameters: This sketch doesn't declare any parameters yet. Add one to expose a control.
normalizeHelp: This will remap the values coming in from their default range to 0 to 1.
noSourcesLinked: No data sources are linked to this visual yet. Link one to map its outputs here.
notFound: This visual could not be opened.
notShared: This visual isn't available to you.
noVisuals: No visuals yet. Create one to start writing a p5 sketch driven by live data.
onlyNumbersMap: Only number parameters can be mapped to a device output for now. Set this one by hand from its controls.
outputsHint: Filter out the outputs this visual won't use. Hidden outputs can't be mapped to a parameter.
sandboxHelp: Allows viewers to add their own data sources and change how the parameters are mapped.
shareDescription: Invite people to build this visual with you, and choose who can open it once it leaves the builder.
sourceUnlinked: Its data source is no longer linked
stuckMappingOff: “{{name}}” is mapped to a data source, but Allow Mapping is off, so nothing reaches it. Unmap it, or turn Allow Mapping back on.
stuckMappingType: “{{name}}” is mapped to a data source, but only number parameters can receive one. Unmap it to set it by hand.
usedInCode: Read in your sketch as params.{{key}}
visualCollectsData: This visual uses data from other devices
waitingForSketch: Waiting for the sketch to declare its parameters…
